_meta.authority: NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Deterministic structuring of controlled current-state evidence; not a qualification decision and not an authorization. No facts are generated from absence.

systems.name: Curling I/O
systems.business_function: League and competition operational data exchange
systems.data_owned: League and competition operational data (bounded domain)
systems.outbound_flows: Governed reference data as permitted within bounded domain
systems.reconciliation: The House is master-data authority for club, affiliation, and participant records; competition/league standing never overrides governed master data.
systems.contract_dependency: Bidirectional operational exchange; terms not captured here
systems.known_limitation: Holds no club or participant master-data authority; bounded to league/competition operational data.

systems.name: Current registration provider (incumbent)
systems.data_owned: Legacy registration and membership data (transition-only authority)
systems.outbound_flows: Migration export to the target platform
systems.reconciliation: Authoritative for legacy data only during transition; authority expires on an explicit recorded migration-completion (cutover) trigger.
systems.contract_dependency: Incumbent agreement; data-export rights and termination/transition conditions must be captured and validated.
systems.known_limitation: Not authoritative for the future target state; migration off the incumbent is a recorded program risk (REG-003).

systems.name: Payment processors
systems.business_function: Payment authorization and capture on instruction
systems.users: Curling Canada finance, clubs, individuals paying fees
systems.inbound_flows: Governed charge instructions from The House
systems.outbound_flows: Payment confirmations/evidence back to The House
systems.reconciliation: Governed decision to charge, fee policy, and resulting record remain in The House; explicit reconciliation boundary with accounting (SYS-008).
systems.contract_dependency: Processor agreement and fee economics (per-transaction cost) require Helene's financial validation.
systems.known_limitation: Does not own fee policy and is not the accounting truth.

systems.name: Sideline Learning
systems.data_owned: Learning/certification completion records (external system of record)
systems.outbound_flows: None governed; The House holds a projection only
systems.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the underlying record
systems.contract_dependency: External SoR agreement; API availability to be validated
systems.known_limitation: The House does not own the underlying learning record
systems.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as external system of record (unproven)

systems.name: Accreditation platforms
systems.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the record
systems.contract_dependency: External SoR agreement; integration availability to be validated
systems.known_limitation: The House does not own the underlying accreditation record
systems.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as external system of record (unproven)

systems.name: Analytics platforms
systems.business_function: Reporting and business intelligence over projected data
systems.reconciliation: Consumes projected data only; MUST NOT become a system of record
systems.known_limitation: Writes no governed state; no authority over underlying records

systems.name: Accounting systems
systems.business_function: Financial ledger and accounting system of record
systems.inbound_flows: Governed charge/payment records synchronized from The House
systems.reconciliation: The House synchronizes and does not overwrite the ledger; explicit boundary with payment processors (SYS-003).
systems.contract_dependency: Accounting platform agreement; requires Helene's validation
systems.known_limitation: The House is not the accounting truth
systems.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as financial system of record (unproven)

systems.name: Support systems (Halo / Zendesk where relevant)
systems.business_function: Support case management and service desk
systems.users: Curling Canada support staff, clubs, individuals
systems.reconciliation: Support cases reference but do not own governed records
systems.known_limitation: Not addressed by ratified Volume 0 authority doctrine

systems.name: Identity and Microsoft 365 services
systems.business_function: Staff identity, email, collaboration, file storage
systems.reconciliation: Email/shared-file processes are manual controls, not governed systems of record; risk of shadow authority.
systems.known_limitation: Not addressed by ratified Volume 0 authority doctrine
systems.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN for identity/productivity; do not treat as SoR (unvalidated)

systems.name: Manual spreadsheets and shared files
systems.business_function: Ad hoc tracking of affiliation, fees, rosters, reconciliation
systems.data_owned: Working copies and manual reconciliation data
systems.outbound_flows: Manual re-keying into systems; email attachments
systems.reconciliation: A recurring reconciliation and data-quality risk; duplicate copies without a single authoritative source.
systems.known_limitation: Untracked authority; a current weakness that must not be recreated in the target platform.

systems.name: Email-mediated processes
systems.business_function: Corrections, follow-ups, approvals conducted over email
systems.users: Curling Canada staff, PTSO staff, clubs
systems.reconciliation: Decisions and evidence live outside a governed store; audit and evidence binding are weak.
systems.known_limitation: Evidence and decisions are not bound to a governed transition; must not be recreated.
systems.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETIRE / replace with governed evidence binding (unvalidated)
